calls.title: Alexis Ruiz-Pedregón and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The discussion centered on restructuring marketing strategies to optimize channels like digital targeting and paid search, with a key focus on retargeting for better conversions. Efforts are underway to enhance content production, significantly increasing output from 4 to about 20 articles per month using AI tools, which has improved SEO visibility. Data infrastructure and analytics are being strengthened through a new data warehouse that integrates CRM systems, allowing for better campaign tracking. The company is experiencing rapid growth with its AI product launches, expanding its workforce substantially. The culture fosters collaboration and innovation, matching the fast-paced startup environment, while the marketing role will evolve towards driving measurable pipeline impacts over time.
calls.keywords: Marketing Build, Demand Generation, AI Content, Google Ads, LinkedIn Targeting, Redis Growth
calls.action_items:
**Alexis Ruiz-Pedregón**
Implement retargeting strategies focusing on website visitors and CRM contacts for Meta and Google Ads campaigns (04:20)
Continue evolving LinkedIn targeting focusing on director+ titles and thought leadership content including articles (12:10)
Launch a marketing leaderboard dashboard for regional teams and aggregate campaign insights using Cloud Code (26:30)
Build Slack alerts for monitoring ad form leads accuracy using Cowork (27:10)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Share insights on Growth Book’s AI-driven targeted messaging and new Slack Claude Tag tool for monitoring internal communications and triggers (27:50)
Support onboarding Alexis with Growth Book marketing channels and early-stage pipeline development strategies (01:00)
Coordinate next steps and feedback for Alexis’s candidacy (28:50)
